1.title: Ken Paxton’s $1,000 Pen Incident Resurfaces in Texas Senate Race
1.summary: The pen Mr. Paxton pocketed more than a decade ago has resurfaced as a campaign issue.

2.title: Missouri Judge Says Redrawn Congressional Map May Be Used in Midterms
2.summary: The decision, quickly appealed, was a win for Republicans. The party has been pushing for the new map in an effort to help maintain control in the U.S. House in November.

3.title: FBI Agents Search Eric Swalwell’s Home as Part of Federal Sexual Assault Inquiry
3.summary: Most sex crimes are prosecuted by state and local authorities. The federal agents appeared to be using civil rights statutes to scrutinize Mr. Swalwell’s conduct, a person familiar with the case said.

4.title: After Six Years, Harry and Meghan Are Coming Home. What Changed?
4.summary: Just last year, Prince Harry said he couldn’t imagine ever bringing his family back to Britain.

5.title: Como mayor bans 'beasts' in city centre after being hit by bike
5.summary: Alessandro Rapinese issues the prohibition for the historic city centre after an encounter with a cyclist last month.

6.title: Togo charges two French journalists over incorrect documents, rights group says
6.summary: Gaël Mocaër and Sebastian Perez Pezzani's detention is "unjustified and disproportionate", Reporters Without Borders says.
